name: map-estate
what: Larkspur's tour, Wed Feb 7 on screen: the Data model opens on its map (ADR 0028 §9, phase 4, the explorer's design): what waits first, as the record has it, without a run: Wed Mar 27 paused, Access reviews arrived empty, 11 outputs waiting on it; then the five kinds of thing with their files and how they relate, a count of what waits on each kind's top edge: the applications their register alone, the controls their catalogue and each one's evidence

name: map-kind
what: Control opened: its register, the catalogue, then each control's evidence (a row an application, Access reviews marked paused), then the files about each control; its neighbours at the edges, each said from its own side in a few words

name: map-file
what: Access reviews: its state on the day the map shows, its rows that day against the 28 days before (the days a smooth shape, its usual part darker, the day a red line at 0 far from them), the outputs that wait on it and what readers see meanwhile, what one row is and the control it is evidence for; Decide opens the day's decision sheet

name: map-rows
what: Its rows beside the map, not in the pipeline: nothing arrived on Wed 27, so the panel reads the day readers see, Tue Mar 26's file as the record keeps it (fetched and checked against its hash), to filter, sort and keep a value's rows; the pipeline a tap further

#dm-map .panel: Tue Mar 26’s, the rows readers see

name: map-links
what: The CMDB, the applications' register: what each application links to and what points to it, each a sentence about one row the same at either end, the controls' evidence one card; its rows against the days before (normal, higher than 27 of them); what it feeds counted once on the other side

name: proposals-ontology
what: Larkspur's tour, Wed Feb 7 (the normal day): the Data model's rules and files (the Ontology page as it was) with backup_jobs open; under it, Proposed from the data (ADR 0022 §5, Q-139, Q-213): the controller column's four values, a band for the last job's common value and the recovery point's three values, each saying what it rests on and what accepting it does, with Accept… and Not now for the owner

pageText: Each is listed as one of its codes, meaning itself until someone words it.
Bands for the common value of Last job
Each band is its usual range five points either side. A day outside one holds the day, by the values check.

name: proposals-quality
what: The same day, tls's Quality tab: under its checks, Proposed from the data: the ingress, issuer and protocol columns' values and a band for private_link, nothing applying until accepted

text: Bands for the 2 common values of private_link

name: proposals-accept-form
what: On the Ontology page (backup_jobs left open), the owner taps Accept… on the controller's values: a reason, the day it takes effect from (the next day to arrive, Mon Apr 1, by default) and what it reaches, and Accept, which waits for the reason

pageText: No recorded day moves: each keeps the rules it ran under.

what: The reason typed and Accept tapped: the values are a change set in force from Mon Apr 1, recorded at once; the card says so with the reason, and the flow's changes list it
